newsitem.title: INDIA: India ONGC to invest 3 bln rupees.
newsitem.headline: India ONGC to invest 3 bln rupees.

text.p: India's state-run Oil and Natural Gas Corp (ONGC) will invest between 2.5 billion and 3.0 billion rupees in deep-sea exploration over two years, its chairman B.C. Bora said on Thursday.
"We plan to take up two sites on the west coast at a depth of about 400 metres," Bora told newsmen after addressing an international seminar on deep sea exploration technology.
He said the sites would be off Kerala-Konkan on the south-west coast and Cauvery on India's eastern coast.
"We are also looking at Saurashtra offshore," he said.
He said ONGC was not planning to explore deep sea in the Bombay High region on the western offshore.
He said the projected investment was for fiscal 1997/98 and 1998/99 (April to March).
ONGC is India's leading oil and gas producer.
